Battle Ground, Washington

Junk removal in Battle Ground

Battle Ground is about twenty eight road miles from our base, up Highway 503 north of Vancouver, in Zone 3. It has a small downtown, newer subdivisions on every side, and acreage out toward Cherry Grove and Meadow Glade.

New subdivisions here mean many families with full garages and leftover moving boxes, while the acreage brings barn and shop cleanouts, old hay feeders and scrap metal. We fit Battle Ground jobs in with our other Clark County stops, so booking a few days out helps.

Every job8 items · Lifting, loading, sweepingIncluded

What comes with every haul, from one couch to a whole house.

  • We do all the lifting, from wherever it is: inside, the garage or the yard
  • We load the truck ourselves, so you carry nothing
  • The crew checks the size with you before loading
  • We sweep the spot where it stood
  • Anything still usable goes to donation
  • Metal, electronics and cardboard go to recycling
  • We text you when we are on the way
  • Photos when we finish, so you can see the space is clear
Move-out cleanouts8 items · What the move left behindWe haul it

For tenants, landlords and sellers: everything left after the move, gone before you hand over the keys.

  • Furniture that did not make the move
  • Mattresses, box springs and bed frames
  • Boxes, bags and loose odds and ends
  • A spare fridge, a washer or a dryer
  • Closet, cabinet and pantry leftovers
  • Rugs and pieces of carpet
  • Patio furniture and outdoor odds and ends
  • Whatever is left in the garage or the shed

Every price and the calculator

Battle Ground questions

Good to know

Do you take scrap metal from a Battle Ground shop?

Yes. Metal goes to a recycler. Very heavy pieces, like engine blocks, need a hand quote.

Can you clear moving boxes after we settle into a new Battle Ground home?

Yes. Flatten them if you can and set them out together. Boxes are priced by how much of the truck they fill.

Is there a travel charge to Battle Ground?

Yes. Battle Ground is in our zone 3, so travel adds $50.00 per visit to the load price. It is shown in your price before you book.

Which Battle Ground ZIP codes do you cover?

All of these: 98604. Type yours in the quote and the price includes travel.
